answer: Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the orchard checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. The terrace graph is rebuilt each epoch, thus the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the canyon audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 5 times its size, so a group of 50 keys loses far more than 50 single identities would. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
